learning_objective: 🎯 We will step outside, collect amazing materials from our surroundings, and learn how to use everyday textures in our art!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Art is hiding in gardens and rooms! We can explore and collect fallen leaves, smooth pebbles, and colorful buttons to use in our drawing books.
Some things feel smooth like glass, and some feel rough like a tree trunk. We can capture these bumpy textures on paper by rubbing crayons over them!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Magic Texture Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Find a coin, a dry leaf, and a plastic comb. Put a thin blank paper over them and gently rub a crayon on top to see their hidden patterns appear!

quick_recap: ⭐ Art is everywhere if we look closely and explore our surroundings.
⭐ Rubbing crayons over rough things makes cool, bumpy patterns.
⭐ Mixing different materials like twigs and paper makes art extra fun!
